remedy.notes: Certified for publication, making it precedential. In the same opinion the trial court’s separate § 1008(d) sanctions award against counsel was vacated and the respondents’ own frivolous-appeal sanctions motion was denied. Counsel’s declaration hedged that the errors "were not willful or AI-driven without review," and footnote 6 reserves on whether every citation error is attributable to AI, but that reservation covers only uncatalogued additional errors, not the fabricated quotations. Charlotin lists the court as the 4th District; it is the First Appellate District, Division Four, and the tracker PDF filename misspells the caption as "Del Baggio."
